"""Readonly two-native-account interval/count diagnosis; no financial replay."""
# ruff: noqa: E402
import os
for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS'):
    os.environ[key] = '1'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback
from copy import deepcopy
from collections.abc import Mapping

import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import canonical_sha256
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evaluation import serialize_evaluation_evidence, validate_evaluation_evidence

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SRC = ROOT / 'research/S013/experiments/EX052_20261011/src'
sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC))
from common import SOURCE_CALLS, cache_read, context

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUTPUT = HERE / 'diagnosis_v3.json'
RUNS = ROOT / 'research/S013/assets/runs/EX052_20261011'


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def plain(value):
    from ledger_reference import plain as native_plain
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {str(k): plain(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        return [plain(v) for v in value]
    return native_plain(value)


def iso(value):
    return None if pd.isna(value) else pd.Timestamp(value).isoformat()


def auth(ctx, label, cfg, reference):
    if label == 'B0-TIME':
        cache = ROOT / '.tmp/s013-mechanism-EX043/parameters/prepared.pkl.gz'
        rows = cache_read(cache)
        row = next(x for x in rows if x['label'] == 'B0-TIME')
        bound, result = row['center'], row['result']
    else:
        cache = ROOT / '.tmp/s013-mechanism-EX052/N0.pkl.gz'
        bound, result = cache_read(cache)
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(reference)
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == 'S013' and digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    formal = read(ref.resolve(ROOT))
    validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
    assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal, 'Entire original formal native serialization drift'
    assert bound.strategy.candidate_id == cfg['candidate_id']
    assert canonical_sha256(bound.strategy.payload) == canonical_sha256(cfg['payload'])
    assert plain(bound.strategy.payload) == cfg['payload']
    identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
    assert identity.content_sha256 == cfg['content_sha256'] == result.runs[0].identity.content_sha256
    assert identity.source_sha256 == cfg['payload']['runtime']['source_sha256']
    assert result.strategy_identity == bound.strategy.runtime_identity_sha256
    assert canonical_sha256(bound.runtime_binding) == result.runtime_binding_hash
    assert len(result.runs) == 1
    return bound, result, {'candidate_id': bound.strategy.candidate_id, 'account_reference': reference,
        'content_sha256': identity.content_sha256, 'source_sha256': identity.source_sha256,
        'dependencies_sha256': identity.dependency_sha256, 'runtime_binding_hash': result.runtime_binding_hash,
        'request_hash': result.request_hash, 'result_hash': result.result_hash,
        'transport': cache.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'transport_sha256': digest(cache),
        'plan_control_payload_and_content': 'EXACT_EQUAL', 'full_original_formal_serialization': 'EXACT_EQUAL'}


def cycles(execution, declared):
    """Link real fills/trades; EOD-day sets come from actual cumulative quantities."""
    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(execution.account_daily.date)).normalize()
    fills, trades = execution.fills, execution.trades
    assert dates.is_unique and dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert trades.cycle_id.is_unique and fills.fill_id.is_unique
    assert set(trades.cycle_id) == set(fills.cycle_id)
    decisions = execution.decisions.set_index('decision_id')
    rows, union = [], set()
    known = {c['cycle_id']: c for c in declared}
    for trade in trades.itertuples():
        actual = fills[fills.cycle_id.eq(trade.cycle_id)].sort_values('fill_time')
        buy, sell = actual[actual.side.eq('BUY')], actual[actual.side.eq('SELL')]
        assert len(buy) and trade.status in ('CLOSED', 'OPEN')
        purchased, sold = int(buy.quantity.sum()), int(sell.quantity.sum())
        assert purchased > 0 and (sold == purchased if trade.status == 'CLOSED' else 0 <= sold < purchased)
        buy_notional = float((buy.quantity * buy.price).sum())
        sell_notional = float((sell.quantity * sell.price).sum())
        assert abs(float(trade.entry_price) - buy_notional / purchased) < 1e-12
        if trade.status == 'CLOSED':
            assert len(sell) and abs(float(trade.exit_price) - sell_notional / sold) < 1e-12
        entry = buy.iloc[0]
        assert pd.Timestamp(trade.entry_date) == pd.Timestamp(entry.fill_time)
        assert trade.quantity == purchased
        exit_fill = sell.iloc[-1] if trade.status == 'CLOSED' else None
        assert (pd.Timestamp(trade.exit_date) == pd.Timestamp(exit_fill.fill_time)) if exit_fill is not None else pd.isna(trade.exit_date)
        entry_decision = decisions.loc[entry.decision_id]
        assert entry_decision.signal_reason == 'entry'
        assert pd.Timestamp(entry.signal_date) == pd.Timestamp(entry_decision.signal_date)
        assert pd.Timestamp(entry.fill_time).normalize() == pd.Timestamp(entry_decision.valid_session).normalize()
        changed = pd.Series(0, index=dates, dtype='int64')
        for fill in actual.itertuples():
            fill_day = pd.Timestamp(fill.fill_time).normalize()
            assert fill_day in dates
            changed.loc[fill_day] += int(fill.quantity) * (1 if fill.side == 'BUY' else -1)
        quantities = changed.cumsum()
        assert quantities.ge(0).all()
        occupied = set(dates[quantities.gt(0)])
        assert occupied and not union.intersection(occupied), 'Cycle occupancy must partition actual position days'
        union |= occupied
        exit_time = None if exit_fill is None else pd.Timestamp(exit_fill.fill_time)
        interval = set(dates[(dates >= pd.Timestamp(entry.fill_time).normalize()) &
                            (dates < exit_time.normalize() if exit_time is not None else True)])
        assert occupied == interval, 'Real fills match [entry-day, exit-day) EOD occupancy'
        row = {'cycle_id': trade.cycle_id, 'status': trade.status, 'entry_fill_time': iso(entry.fill_time),
            'entry_signal_date': iso(entry.signal_date), 'entry_route': entry_decision.regime,
            'exit_fill_time': iso(exit_time), 'exit_signal_date': None if exit_fill is None else iso(exit_fill.signal_date),
            'exit_reason': None if exit_fill is None else decisions.loc[exit_fill.decision_id].signal_reason,
            'actual_quantity': purchased, 'sold_quantity': sold, 'remaining_quantity': purchased - sold,
            'fill_count': len(actual), 'actual_fills': plain(actual.to_dict('records')),
            'weighted_entry_price': buy_notional / purchased,
            'weighted_exit_price': None if not sold else sell_notional / sold, 'holding_eod_days': [d.date().isoformat() for d in sorted(occupied)],
            'holding_eod_day_count': len(occupied), 'entry_fill_trigger': entry.trigger,
            'exit_fill_trigger': None if exit_fill is None else exit_fill.trigger}
        actual_declared = known[trade.cycle_id]
        for key in ('status', 'entry_fill_time', 'entry_signal_date', 'entry_route', 'exit_fill_time', 'exit_signal_date', 'exit_reason'):
            assert row[key] == actual_declared.get(key), key
        if exit_time is not None:
            assert len(occupied) == actual_declared['holding_sessions']
        rows.append(row)
    assert union == set(dates[execution.account_daily.quantity.gt(0)]), 'All actual account holding days covered exactly once'
    assert len(rows) == len(known)
    return rows, union


KINDS = ('same_price_interval', 'one_to_one_changed_execution', 'several_old_to_one_new',
         'one_old_to_several_new', 'many_to_many', 'old_only', 'new_only')


def formal_json(reference):
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(reference)
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == 'S013' and digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    return read(ref.resolve(ROOT))


def key(c):
    return tuple(c.get(n) for n in ('entry_fill_time', 'exit_fill_time', 'entry_route', 'status', 'entry_price', 'exit_price'))


def main():
    assert not OUTPUT.exists(), 'Never overwrite completed diagnosis'
    method = read(HERE / 'method_v3.json')
    assert method['source_sha256'] == digest(Path(__file__))
    for item in method['input_metadata']:
        assert digest(ROOT / item['path']) == item['sha256']
    plan_path, refs_path = SRC.parent / 'protocols/plan.json', RUNS / 'account_references.json'
    plan, refs, analysis = read(plan_path), read(refs_path), read(RUNS / 'analysis.json')
    assert formal_json(read(SRC.parent / 'protocols/plan_reference.json')) == plan
    assert analysis['status'] == 'PASS' and read(RUNS / 'precheck.json')['status'] == 'PASS'
    cfgs = {c['label']: c for c in plan['controls'] + plan['configurations']}
    assert refs['B0-TIME'] == plan['control_references']['B0-TIME'] == analysis['control_reuse']['B0-TIME']['reference']
    ctx = context(1)
    accounts = {label: auth(ctx, label, cfgs[label], refs[label]) for label in ('B0-TIME', 'N0')}
    for label, (_, result, audit) in accounts.items():
        for field in ('request_hash', 'result_hash'):
            assert audit[field] == analysis['rows'][label][field]
        assert audit['content_sha256'] == analysis['rows'][label]['content_sha256']
    assert accounts['B0-TIME'][2]['dependencies_sha256'] == accounts['N0'][2]['dependencies_sha256']
    parameters = [deepcopy(plain(accounts[label][0].strategy.payload)['parameters']) for label in accounts]
    assert parameters[1].pop('mechanism') == 'BEAR_CONSENSUS_ACF20' and parameters[0] == parameters[1]
    old, new = (accounts[label][1].runs[0].execution for label in accounts)
    for field in ('decisions', 'orders', 'fills', 'account_daily', 'trades'):
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(getattr(accounts['B0-TIME'][1].runs[0].buyhold.execution, field),
                                      getattr(accounts['N0'][1].runs[0].buyhold.execution, field), check_exact=True)
    for name in ('date', 'signal_date', 'close'):
        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(old.account_daily[name], new.account_daily[name], check_exact=True)
    features = ['signal_date', 'valid_session', 'close', 'acf1', 'momentum20', 'regime', 'regime_momentum',
                'bull_range_position', 'bear_range_position', 'confirmation_score', 'confirmation_acf',
                'confirmation_turnover', 'confirmation_volume']
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old.decisions[features], new.decisions[features], check_exact=True)
    assert set(new.decisions.columns) == set(old.decisions.columns) | {'bear_acf_value'}
    cycle_rows, occupied = {}, {}
    for label, execution in [('B0-TIME', old), ('N0', new)]:
        rows, occupied[label] = cycles(execution, analysis['rows'][label]['paths']['cycles'])
        known = {c['cycle_id']: c for c in analysis['rows'][label]['paths']['cycles']}
        native = execution.trades.set_index('cycle_id')
        for row in rows:
            row.update({n: known[row['cycle_id']][n] for n in ('buy_notional', 'sell_notional', 'fees', 'buy_fees', 'sell_fees')})
            for n in ('gross_price_pnl', 'net_pnl', 'gross_return', 'net_return'):
                row[n] = known[row['cycle_id']].get(n)
            trade = native.loc[row['cycle_id']]
            row.update(entry_price=float(trade.entry_price), exit_price=None if pd.isna(trade.exit_price) else float(trade.exit_price))
            if row['status'] == 'CLOSED':
                assert abs(row['net_return'] - float(trade.net_return)) < 1e-12
                assert abs(row['net_pnl'] - (row['sell_notional'] - row['buy_notional'] - row['fees'])) < 1e-6
        cycle_rows[label] = rows
    ar, br = cycle_rows['B0-TIME'], cycle_rows['N0']
    graph = {('old', i): set() for i in range(len(ar))} | {('new', i): set() for i in range(len(br))}
    for i, a in enumerate(ar):
        for j, b in enumerate(br):
            if set(a['holding_eod_days']) & set(b['holding_eod_days']):
                graph['old', i].add(('new', j))
                graph['new', j].add(('old', i))
    groups, seen = [], set()
    for node in graph:
        if node in seen:
            continue
        stack, component = [node], set()
        while stack:
            item = stack.pop()
            if item not in component:
                component.add(item)
                stack.extend(graph[item] - component)
        seen |= component
        oi, ni = sorted(i for side, i in component if side == 'old'), sorted(i for side, i in component if side == 'new')
        if not oi:
            kind = 'new_only'
        elif not ni:
            kind = 'old_only'
        elif len(oi) == len(ni) == 1:
            kind = 'same_price_interval' if key(ar[oi[0]]) == key(br[ni[0]]) else 'one_to_one_changed_execution'
        elif len(oi) > 1 and len(ni) == 1:
            kind = 'several_old_to_one_new'
        elif len(oi) == 1 and len(ni) > 1:
            kind = 'one_old_to_several_new'
        else:
            kind = 'many_to_many'
        groups.append({'kind': kind, 'old_indices': oi, 'new_indices': ni,
            'old_closed': sum(ar[i]['status'] == 'CLOSED' for i in oi),
            'new_closed': sum(br[i]['status'] == 'CLOSED' for i in ni)})
    assert len(seen) == len(ar) + len(br)
    assert sum(g['old_closed'] for g in groups) == 112
    assert sum(g['new_closed'] for g in groups) == 107
    summary = [{ 'kind': k, 'groups': sum(g['kind'] == k for g in groups),
        'old_closed': sum(g['old_closed'] for g in groups if g['kind'] == k),
        'new_closed': sum(g['new_closed'] for g in groups if g['kind'] == k)} for k in KINDS]
    same = [g for g in groups if g['kind'] == 'same_price_interval']
    same_cash = []
    for g in same:
        a, b = ar[g['old_indices'][0]], br[g['new_indices'][0]]
        if a['actual_quantity'] != b['actual_quantity'] or a['fees'] != b['fees']:
            same_cash.append({'old_index': g['old_indices'][0], 'new_index': g['new_indices'][0],
                'old_quantity': a['actual_quantity'], 'new_quantity': b['actual_quantity'],
                'gross_return_exact': a['gross_return'] == b['gross_return'],
                'old_fees': a['fees'], 'new_fees': b['fees'], 'old_net_pnl': a['net_pnl'], 'new_net_pnl': b['net_pnl']})
    effect = formal_json(plan['effect_reference'])
    assert effect['status'] == 'PASS'
    assert effect['method_reference'] == read(SRC.parent / 'protocols/effect_method_reference.json')
    formal_json(effect['method_reference'])
    losses = [r for r in effect['accounts']['center']['all_days'] if r['actual'][0] == 1 and r['conditional_probe'][0] == 0]
    assert len(losses) == 5
    loss_rows = []
    for r in losses:
        d = pd.Timestamp(r['signal_date'])
        ad = old.decisions.loc[pd.to_datetime(old.decisions.signal_date).eq(d)].iloc[0]
        bd = new.decisions.loc[pd.to_datetime(new.decisions.signal_date).eq(d)].iloc[0]
        assert ad.signal_reason == 'entry' and ad.regime == 'bear'
        indices = [i for i, c in enumerate(ar) if pd.Timestamp(c['entry_signal_date']).normalize() == d.normalize()]
        assert len(indices) == 1
        loss_rows.append({'signal_date': r['signal_date'], 'execution_date': r['execution_date'],
            'raw_acf': r['raw_acf'], 'consensus_acf': r['consensus_acf'], 'old_cycle_index': indices[0],
            'old_actual_target': float(ad.target_position), 'old_actual_reason': ad.signal_reason,
            'new_actual_target': float(bd.target_position), 'new_actual_reason': bd.signal_reason})
    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(old.account_daily.date)).normalize()
    yearly = []
    for year in sorted(set(dates.year)):
        row = {'year': int(year)}
        for label, execution in [('B0-TIME', old), ('N0', new)]:
            segment = execution.account_daily.loc[dates.year == year]
            annual = next(r for r in analysis['rows'][label]['paths']['annual_account'] if r['year'] == year)
            assert abs(annual['closing_equity'] - float(segment.equity.iloc[-1])) < 1e-8
            assert abs(annual['net_pnl'] - (annual['closing_equity'] - annual['opening_equity'])) < 1e-6
            row[label] = {'annual_actual': annual,
                'closed_by_exit_year': sum(c['status'] == 'CLOSED' and pd.Timestamp(c['exit_fill_time']).year == year for c in cycle_rows[label]),
                'holding_days': len(occupied[label] & set(dates[dates.year == year]))}
        yearly.append(row)
    changed_old = [i for g in groups if g['kind'] != 'same_price_interval' for i in g['old_indices']]
    changed_new = [i for g in groups if g['kind'] != 'same_price_interval' for i in g['new_indices']]
    opposite_daily = []
    for i in changed_old:
        cycle = ar[i]
        start = pd.Timestamp(cycle['entry_fill_time']).normalize()
        end = dates[-1] if cycle['exit_fill_time'] is None else pd.Timestamp(cycle['exit_fill_time']).normalize()
        days = dates[(dates >= start) & (dates <= end)]
        rows = []
        for day in days:
            own = new.account_daily.loc[pd.to_datetime(new.account_daily.date).dt.normalize().eq(day)]
            fs = new.fills.loc[pd.to_datetime(new.fills.fill_time).dt.normalize().eq(day)]
            rows.append({'date': day.date().isoformat(), 'new_actual_account': plain(own.to_dict('records')),
                         'new_actual_fills': plain(fs.to_dict('records'))})
        opposite_daily.append({'old_cycle_index': i, 'new_actual_daily_during_old_cycle': rows})
    # Native actual budget/order facts for matched-price cycles distinguish quantities from price-interval equality.
    entry_budget = {}
    for label, execution in [('B0-TIME', old), ('N0', new)]:
        rows = []
        for fill in execution.fills.loc[execution.fills.side.eq('BUY')].itertuples():
            order = execution.orders.loc[execution.orders.order_id.eq(fill.order_id)]
            rows.append({'cycle_id': fill.cycle_id, 'orders': plain(order.to_dict('records')), 'fill': plain(fill._asdict())})
        entry_budget[label] = rows
    tails = {label: [c for c in cs if c['status'] == 'OPEN'] for label, cs in cycle_rows.items()}
    assert len(tails['B0-TIME']) == len(tails['N0']) == 1
    out = {'status': 'PASS', 'method': method, 'source_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)),
        'new_account_preparations': 0, 'new_account_evaluations': 0, 'cash_replays': 0, 'provider_calls': SOURCE_CALLS,
        'account_authentication': {label: a[2] for label, a in accounts.items()}, 'five_buyhold_ledgers': 'EXACT_EQUAL',
        'original13_parameter_values_and_all_original_causal_features': 'EXACT_EQUAL',
        'summary': {'old_closed': 112, 'new_closed': 107, 'closed_difference': -5, 'component_summary': summary,
            'old_total_cycles': len(ar), 'new_total_cycles': len(br), 'old_open_tails': 1, 'new_open_tails': 1,
            'same_price_intervals_with_cash_quantity_fee_differences': len(same_cash),
            'conditional_old_state_loss_events': 5,
            'target_changed_days': int(old.decisions.target_position.ne(new.decisions.target_position).sum()),
            'reason_changed_days': int(old.decisions.signal_reason.ne(new.decisions.signal_reason).sum())},
        'cycles': cycle_rows, 'overlap_components': groups, 'same_price_interval_cash_facts': same_cash,
        'changed_old_cycle_indices': changed_old, 'changed_new_cycle_indices': changed_new,
        'opposite_daily_for_changed_old_cycles': opposite_daily, 'conditional_loss_actual_links': loss_rows,
        'all_years_actual': yearly, 'actual_entry_order_budget_facts': entry_budget, 'open_tail_cycles': tails,
        'tail_price_interval_equal': key(tails['B0-TIME'][0]) == key(tails['N0'][0]),
        'limits': method['limits']}
    assert not SOURCE_CALLS
    # Imported plain serializer handles public timestamps, enums and mapping fields only.
    from ledger_reference import plain as native_plain
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(native_plain(out), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(out['summary'], ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as error:
        failure = HERE / 'technical_failure_v3.json'
        assert not failure.exists(), 'Preserve failed source and evidence'
        failure.write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'FAILED', 'new_account_evaluations': 0,
            'source_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)), 'error_type': type(error).__name__, 'error': str(error),
            'traceback': traceback.format_exc()}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        raise

"""Readonly two-native-account interval/count diagnosis; no financial replay."""
# ruff: noqa: E402
import os
for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS'):
    os.environ[key] = '1'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback
from copy import deepcopy

import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import canonical_sha256
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evidence import EvidenceRef
from czsc_trader.research_tools.evaluation import serialize_evaluation_evidence, validate_evaluation_evidence

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SRC = ROOT / 'research/S013/experiments/EX052_20261011/src'
sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC))
from common import SOURCE_CALLS, cache_read, context

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUTPUT = HERE / 'diagnosis.json'
RUNS = ROOT / 'research/S013/assets/runs/EX052_20261011'


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def plain(value):
    from ledger_reference import plain as native_plain
    return native_plain(value)


def iso(value):
    return None if pd.isna(value) else pd.Timestamp(value).isoformat()


def auth(ctx, label, cfg, reference):
    if label == 'B0-TIME':
        cache = ROOT / '.tmp/s013-mechanism-EX043/parameters/prepared.pkl.gz'
        rows = cache_read(cache)
        row = next(x for x in rows if x['label'] == 'B0-TIME')
        bound, result = row['center'], row['result']
    else:
        cache = ROOT / '.tmp/s013-mechanism-EX052/N0.pkl.gz'
        bound, result = cache_read(cache)
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(reference)
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == 'S013' and digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    formal = read(ref.resolve(ROOT))
    validate_evaluation_evidence(formal)
    assert serialize_evaluation_evidence(bound, result) == formal, 'Entire original formal native serialization drift'
    assert bound.strategy.candidate_id == cfg['candidate_id'] and plain(bound.strategy.payload) == cfg['payload']
    identity = ctx.runtime.identify(bound.strategy, dependencies=bound.dependencies)
    assert identity.content_sha256 == cfg['content_sha256'] == result.runs[0].identity.content_sha256
    assert identity.source_sha256 == cfg['payload']['runtime']['source_sha256']
    assert result.strategy_identity == bound.strategy.runtime_identity_sha256
    assert canonical_sha256(bound.runtime_binding) == result.runtime_binding_hash
    assert len(result.runs) == 1
    return bound, result, {'candidate_id': bound.strategy.candidate_id, 'account_reference': reference,
        'content_sha256': identity.content_sha256, 'source_sha256': identity.source_sha256,
        'dependencies_sha256': identity.dependency_sha256, 'runtime_binding_hash': result.runtime_binding_hash,
        'request_hash': result.request_hash, 'result_hash': result.result_hash,
        'transport': cache.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'transport_sha256': digest(cache),
        'plan_control_payload_and_content': 'EXACT_EQUAL', 'full_original_formal_serialization': 'EXACT_EQUAL'}


def cycles(execution, declared):
    """Link real fills/trades; EOD-day sets come from actual cumulative quantities."""
    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(execution.account_daily.date)).normalize()
    fills, trades = execution.fills, execution.trades
    assert dates.is_unique and dates.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert trades.cycle_id.is_unique and fills.fill_id.is_unique
    assert set(trades.cycle_id) == set(fills.cycle_id)
    decisions = execution.decisions.set_index('decision_id')
    rows, union = [], set()
    known = {c['cycle_id']: c for c in declared}
    for trade in trades.itertuples():
        actual = fills[fills.cycle_id.eq(trade.cycle_id)].sort_values('fill_time')
        buy, sell = actual[actual.side.eq('BUY')], actual[actual.side.eq('SELL')]
        assert len(buy) == 1 and len(sell) == (1 if trade.status == 'CLOSED' else 0), 'Unexpected multi-fill structure'
        entry = buy.iloc[0]
        assert pd.Timestamp(trade.entry_date) == pd.Timestamp(entry.fill_time)
        assert trade.quantity == int(entry.quantity)
        exit_fill = sell.iloc[-1] if len(sell) else None
        assert (pd.Timestamp(trade.exit_date) == pd.Timestamp(exit_fill.fill_time)) if exit_fill is not None else pd.isna(trade.exit_date)
        entry_decision = decisions.loc[entry.decision_id]
        assert entry_decision.signal_reason == 'entry'
        assert pd.Timestamp(entry.signal_date) == pd.Timestamp(entry_decision.signal_date)
        assert pd.Timestamp(entry.fill_time).normalize() == pd.Timestamp(entry_decision.valid_session).normalize()
        if exit_fill is not None:
            assert int(exit_fill.quantity) == int(entry.quantity)
        changed = pd.Series(0, index=dates, dtype='int64')
        for fill in actual.itertuples():
            fill_day = pd.Timestamp(fill.fill_time).normalize()
            assert fill_day in dates
            changed.loc[fill_day] += int(fill.quantity) * (1 if fill.side == 'BUY' else -1)
        quantities = changed.cumsum()
        assert quantities.ge(0).all()
        occupied = set(dates[quantities.gt(0)])
        assert occupied and not union.intersection(occupied), 'Cycle occupancy must partition actual position days'
        union |= occupied
        exit_time = None if exit_fill is None else pd.Timestamp(exit_fill.fill_time)
        interval = set(dates[(dates >= pd.Timestamp(entry.fill_time).normalize()) &
                            (dates < exit_time.normalize() if exit_time is not None else True)])
        assert occupied == interval, 'Real fills match [entry-day, exit-day) EOD occupancy'
        row = {'cycle_id': trade.cycle_id, 'status': trade.status, 'entry_fill_time': iso(entry.fill_time),
            'entry_signal_date': iso(entry.signal_date), 'entry_route': entry_decision.regime,
            'exit_fill_time': iso(exit_time), 'exit_signal_date': None if exit_fill is None else iso(exit_fill.signal_date),
            'exit_reason': None if exit_fill is None else decisions.loc[exit_fill.decision_id].signal_reason,
            'actual_quantity': int(entry.quantity), 'holding_eod_days': [d.date().isoformat() for d in sorted(occupied)],
            'holding_eod_day_count': len(occupied), 'entry_fill_trigger': entry.trigger,
            'exit_fill_trigger': None if exit_fill is None else exit_fill.trigger}
        actual_declared = known[trade.cycle_id]
        for key in ('status', 'entry_fill_time', 'entry_signal_date', 'entry_route', 'exit_fill_time', 'exit_signal_date', 'exit_reason'):
            assert row[key] == actual_declared.get(key), key
        if exit_time is not None:
            assert len(occupied) == actual_declared['holding_sessions']
        rows.append(row)
    assert union == set(dates[execution.account_daily.quantity.gt(0)]), 'All actual account holding days covered exactly once'
    assert len(rows) == len(known)
    return rows, union


KINDS = ('same_price_interval', 'one_to_one_retimed', 'several_old_to_one_new',
         'one_old_to_several_new', 'many_to_many', 'old_only', 'new_only')


def formal_json(reference):
    ref = EvidenceRef.from_dict(reference)
    assert ref.experiment.strategy_id == 'S013' and digest(ref.resolve(ROOT)) == ref.sha256
    return read(ref.resolve(ROOT))


def key(c):
    return tuple(c.get(n) for n in ('entry_fill_time', 'exit_fill_time', 'entry_route', 'status', 'entry_price', 'exit_price'))


def main():
    assert not OUTPUT.exists(), 'Never overwrite completed diagnosis'
    method = read(HERE / 'method.json')
    assert method['source_sha256'] == digest(Path(__file__))
    for item in method['input_metadata']:
        assert digest(ROOT / item['path']) == item['sha256']
    plan_path, refs_path = SRC.parent / 'protocols/plan.json', RUNS / 'account_references.json'
    plan, refs, analysis = read(plan_path), read(refs_path), read(RUNS / 'analysis.json')
    assert formal_json(read(SRC.parent / 'protocols/plan_reference.json')) == plan
    assert analysis['status'] == 'PASS' and read(RUNS / 'precheck.json')['status'] == 'PASS'
    cfgs = {c['label']: c for c in plan['controls'] + plan['configurations']}
    assert refs['B0-TIME'] == plan['control_references']['B0-TIME'] == analysis['control_reuse']['B0-TIME']['reference']
    ctx = context(1)
    accounts = {label: auth(ctx, label, cfgs[label], refs[label]) for label in ('B0-TIME', 'N0')}
    for label, (_, result, audit) in accounts.items():
        for field in ('request_hash', 'result_hash'):
            assert audit[field] == analysis['rows'][label][field]
        assert audit['content_sha256'] == analysis['rows'][label]['content_sha256']
    assert accounts['B0-TIME'][2]['dependencies_sha256'] == accounts['N0'][2]['dependencies_sha256']
    parameters = [deepcopy(plain(accounts[label][0].strategy.payload)['parameters']) for label in accounts]
    assert parameters[1].pop('mechanism') == 'BEAR_CONSENSUS_ACF20' and parameters[0] == parameters[1]
    old, new = (accounts[label][1].runs[0].execution for label in accounts)

    features = ['signal_date', 'valid_session', 'close', 'acf1', 'momentum20', 'regime', 'regime_momentum',

    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old.decisions[features], new.decisions[features], check_exact=True)
    assert set(new.decisions.columns) == set(old.decisions.columns) | {'bear_acf_value'}
    cycle_rows, occupied = {}, {}

    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
